Enum ListStyle

Namespace
ParquetNeo
Assembly
ParquetNeo.Enums.dll

How a list is laid out in the schema. Writers have used several; readers must accept them all.

public enum ListStyle

Fields

Implicit = 4

A repeated field outside any LIST group: a list of required elements of the field's type.

RepeatedPrimitive = 1

A LIST group holding a repeated primitive, which is the element (required).

RepeatedStruct = 2

A LIST group holding a repeated group with several fields, which is the element (a struct, required).

RepeatedTuple = 3

A LIST group holding a repeated group with one field named array or {list}_tuple, which is the element (a struct, required).

ThreeLevel = 0

The standard layout: a LIST group holding a repeated group that holds the element (which may be optional).
